alt: 大人推著裝滿鬆散鐵鍋的車穿過院子，居民掩耳望來，雞在籠旁拍翅，小狗隔著院門吠叫。
scene_prompt: A quiet residential courtyard has become chaotic because a careless adult rolls a rattling cart of loose empty metal pots loudly across the stone paving. Residents cover their ears or lean from windows in distress, a startled hen flaps beside a coop and a small dog barks from behind a safely latched garden gate. A baby stroller under a shaded porch is being gently rocked by a tired parent. The noisy cart is the obvious common source disturbing everyone. No text or sound lettering, no injuries, no collision, no frightening violence. Limit to a few clearly separated figures and natural animal anatomy.
